sentences.text:
5. Learned Advocate for the appellant further pointed out the paragraph No.2 of the compromise terms executed before LokAdalat which reads as under:-
 "2.a) The acquiring body has agreed to pay compensation to  the appellants/claimants as per legal opinion of GMIDC legal  cell two groups are formed for Village Koregaon for first group  rate awarded by SLAO is below Rs.640/- per R then at rate of  Rs.2400/- per R for Dry land, Rs.3600/- per R for semi irrigated  land, Rs.4800/- per R for irrigated land, Rs.1200/- per R for Pot  Kharab land OR Four Times of the Rate Awarded by SLAO  whichever is less.
 b) for second group rate awarded by SLAO is above 640/-
 per R then at rate of Rs.2600/- per R for Dry land, Rs.3900/- per  R for semi irrigated land, Rs.5200/- per R for irrigated land,
 Rs.1300/- per R for Pot Kharab land OR Four Times of the Rate  awarded by SLAO less and the appellants/Claimants agreed to  deduct rate i.e. already received in Reference Court and the  classification of land would be consider as per award passed by  SLAO or Reference Court."
6.
Learned Advocate for the claimant submitted to award compensation in terms of the said compromise.
7. Learned AGP for the State also submitted that in view of the compromise, the same amount of compensation may be awarded to the 923 FA 1273.2014.odt 2 of 3  claimant.

8. Considering the compromise recorded in the proceedings arising out of same acquisition of land before Mahalokadalat the appellant/claimant is entitled to the same rate of compensation i.e. Rs.3600/- per R for semi irrigated land and Rs.1300/- per R for Barren/Pot Kharab land.

Hence, the following order:-
ORDER i. The First Appeal is allowed.

ii. The impugned judgment and award passed by the learned Reference Court is set aside and modified as under:
a) The appellant/claimant is entitled to the compensation @ 3600/- per R for semi irrigated land and Rs.1300/- per R for Barren/Pot Kharaba land.
iii.
The appellant/claimant is not entitled for statutory interest i.e. 15% under Section 28 of the Land Acquisition Act for the delayed period, which was condoned by this Court, if any.

iv. The enhanced amount of compensation with statutory interest etc. shall be deposited in this Court within a period of six months from today and on payment of deficit Court fee, if any, it be paid to the appellant.
v. The award be drawn up accordingly.

(SANJAY A. DESHMUKH, J.)
